selected_experiment.question: Before inventing another representation, how much of the deep-list substitution workload is already eliminated by exact substitution memoization, loose-range closed-subtree skips, compiled node reuse, and spine reuse?

classification_rule.input_reuse_saturated: (substHits + rangeSkips) / (substHits + substMisses + rangeSkips) >= 0.80 in both cases

post_result_policy.if_input_reuse_saturated: compile separator that the input-side substitution quotient is already largely captured; move to output construction/allocation consequence reduction
post_result_policy.if_input_reuse_sparse: prospectively test a stronger exact substitution consequence index
post_result_policy.if_mixed: split the frontier by the observed reuse regime before another optimization

claim_boundary: Diagnostic accounting of existing verified caches and exact closed-subtree skips only. Aggregate counters do not prove every hit occurs inside isValidChar_UInt32 and do not authorize new semantics.
